model: claude-sonnet-5 (Claude Code session, direct image read, no Anthropic Messages API call)
method: Revised 2026-07-23: the source PDF (inputs/incoming/DEICO_DE12XXX_Technical_Drawing.pdf) was read directly inside a Claude Code conversation, using both the rendered page image and the PDF's embedded text layer (the original pass used the rendered image only). A raw JSON response was hand-written against the rules in src/technical_drawing_parser/extraction/prompt.py (build_vlm_prompt) and the schema in product.py, then passed through the real parse_product_json_response and format_json_compact so the final shape matches what the pipeline would produce from that raw response. This revision fixed a paraphrased legal-notice note (same DEICO boilerplate confirmed verbatim across all 5 samples) and added the schematics field (empty; this drawing has no schematic content), which was missing from the original pass since it predates that schema field. Because text-layer access is not available to the real image-only VLM call, this file is a hand-derived reference for checking prompt/schema correctness, not a simulation of real Anthropic/Ollama image-only extraction quality (see outputs_claude_code_blind_test/ for that).
purpose: Comparison baseline against outputs_claude_sonnet_test/products/deico_de12xxx.json (produced via the Anthropic API) without spending API budget or overwriting that result.
